concern_details.detail: main system components involved in seat booking
concern_details.why: The seven components match the code on the booking path. Swing wizard (DateAndRoomSelection/TimeSlotSelection/AreaSelection/ReservationSummary) and the Spring REST controllers both call LibraryFacade. LibraryFacade delegates to StudyRoomManager (getAvailableStudyRooms/TimeSlots/RoomDetail, LibraryFacade.java:79-101) and ReservationManager (makeReservation, :118). ReservationManager uses the registries/entities (ReservationManager.java:28-30) and NotificationManager (:121). NotificationManager sends through NotificationServiceAdapter -> ExternalEmailGateway. The blue fill marks the two components a developer changing booking will edit.

The numbered «use» dependencies give the control flow: 1 browse availability (front end -> facade -> Study Room Manager), 2 makeReservation (front end -> facade -> Reservation Manager), 3 check/assign/save against the domain, 4 notify. This matches makeReservation (ReservationManager.java:65-96): resolve, validateSeatInArea, availableSeats, selectSeat (Seat.isAvailable or strategy when seatId=0), createAndSave via ReservationRegistry, notifyReservation. The labels now say correctly that the binding availability check is in Reservation Manager and that Study Room Manager is for display only. The fixes from critique-1 are all applied.

level_why: Seven components with one-line responsibilities and four numbered steps suit an overview for a developer. Strategy, state classes, registries, DTOs, UserManager and NotificationScheduler are correctly folded in or left out. Nothing needs cutting: each box is on the booking path, and Notification is triggered on every successful booking. Adding anything finer, such as separate strategy/registry boxes or the NotificationService interface, would go past overview.
uml: Minor: one dependency edge carries two step numbers ('1 browse availability, 2 makeReservation'), so the numbering mixes sequence ordering into a structural diagram. This is acceptable at overview and the legend explains it, so no change is required.
